label: Verified
description: Supported by current primary sources or direct documentary evidence and ready to be represented as verified if separately approved.

label: Supported
description: Supported by identified material but still carrying caveats, scope limits or review needs.

label: Qualified
description: Usable only with explicit limitations, conditions or governance caveats.

label: Unresolved
description: Not yet resolved and not to be represented as settled.

label: Unable to Verify
description: Could not presently be verified from available material.

label: Contradicted
description: Contradicted by stronger or more current material.

label: Withdrawn
description: Withdrawn from use and not to be relied upon.

label: Superseded
description: Replaced by a more current or more authoritative record.
